strengths: Very fast and cheap per token
Strong for classification, extraction, summarization at volume
weaknesses: Less capable on complex multi-step reasoning
Less robust agentic behavior than Sonnet/Opus
prompting_quirks: Keep prompts focused and specific: it does less heavy lifting on ambiguity
Few-shot examples particularly helpful for classification tasks
best_for: Real-time UI helpers where latency matters
First-pass triage before escalating to a larger model
avoid_for: Architecture decisions or complex code generation
Tasks requiring chain-of-thought across many steps
notes: The fast tier. Use it for the 80% of calls that don't need a frontier model.
pricing_notes: Standard rate. Verify before budgeting: rate may have shifted since Haiku 4.5 launch.
